instruction: A plump scarab beetle whose entire shell is cut into sharp crystalline facets like a polished emerald. Deep green and teal gem planes refract light across the domed wing cases, while the six angular legs and horned head glint amber-gold. It sits centered and symmetrical, sparkling as though carved from a single precious stone.
